notes: OO's docx part container (document, styles, numbering, footnotes, endnotes, settings, comments(+4 ext parts), fontTable, hdr/ftr, theme, app, core, vbaProject, jsaProject). WO OoxmlParser::parse_docx_body + OoxmlSerializer handle document.xml, styles.xml, footnotes.xml (verbatim), header/footer1, comments+commentsExtended, media, core.xml. Not read/emitted: endnotes.xml, settings.xml, fontTable.xml, app.xml, theme1.xml, customXml, vbaProject, jsaProject, numbering.xml is only ever WRITTEN from a fixed template.

Flat OPC (single-XML word document, .xml Word 2003/flat OPC) container. wo-ooxml has no flat-OPC reader; router only sniffs zip-based OPC (router.rs sniff_opc_family). Word2003XmlToDocxConverter (wo-x2t converters.rs:780) covers the legacy WordML dialect, not flat OPC.

document.xml root part (611 lines: background, docSuppData, body). WO: parse_docx_body -> DocxBody{blocks,media,image_rels,hyperlink_rels,footnotes_raw,raw_sect_pr,header,footer,comments,comment_anchors}. w:background and w:docSuppData have no model slot.
w:background (document-wide page/VML background). No field in OoxmlDocument/DocxBody; dropped at parse.
w:docSuppData (binary suppdata for legacy fields). No WO counterpart.

styles.xml part (750 lines). WO OoxmlParser::parse_styles reads w:style type=paragraph|character|table into DocxStyles; serializer build_styles_xml re-emits. No docDefaults, latentStyles, style link/next/aliases/uiPriority/qFormat, numbering-linked styles.

Per-style entry. WO DocxParagraphStyle{style_id,name,based_on,properties,run_properties} / DocxCharacterStyle / DocxTableStyle(id+name only). Missing: next, link, autoRedefine, hidden, semiHidden, unhideWhenUsed, qFormat, locked, personal*.
w:docDefaults (rPrDefault/pPrDefault inheritance root). parse_styles skips it; DocxStyles has no defaults field, so default fonts/size/lang of foreign docx are lost.
w:latentStyles + w:lsdException (style hints for Word UI). Not modeled.
Single latent-style exception row. Not modeled.
tblPr/tcPr inside a table style (conditional formatting of firstRow/band1 etc.). DocxTableStyle carries only style_id+name, so table-style borders/shading are dropped.

numbering.xml part (946 lines). Parser never reads numbering.xml (grep: no numbering in parser.rs); OoxmlSerializer::build_numbering_xml emits a FIXED 8-abstractNum template (numId 1/7/8 bullets, 2-6 decimal) only when body_uses_numbering(). Foreign numbering definitions collapse to these.
w:abstractNum. Only the fixed template inside build_numbering_xml exists; no parse or per-document abstractNum model.
w:lvl (numFmt/lvlText/start/ind per level). build_numbering_xml emits 6 levels per abstractNum with decimal|bullet only; no lowerLetter/upperRoman/none formats, no lvlOverride.
w:num -> abstractNumId mapping. HtmlToDocxConverter hardcodes numIds (tests/converter_gaps.rs c2_2b_list_style_type_roundtrip expects numId 4 = lower-roman, 7 = circle, 8 = square).
w:numPicBullet (picture bullets). No model slot.
w:multiLevelType (hybridMultilevel etc.). Fixed template always singleLevel-style; not modeled.
Custom XML bibliography part (sources/citations). No parse or serialize path anywhere in wo-ooxml or wo-x2t (grep bibliography: zero hits in crates).
comments.xml (929 lines). WO Comment{id,author,date,text,resolved,parent_id} + parse_comments + build_comments_xml. Comment bodies flatten to plain text (runs/formatting in a comment lost).
Single comment entry -> wo-ooxml model::Comment. Anchors in document.xml tracked as CommentAnchor::{Start,End,Reference} marker runs (F-102), re-emitted in run order.
commentsExtended.xml (w15: paraId/done/parent). build_comments_extended_xml re-emits resolved + parent_id; paraIds themselves are regenerated, not preserved.
commentsExt.xml (w16cid durable ids). Not read or written.
commentsIds.xml. Not modeled.
commentsExtensible.xml. Not modeled.
commentsUserData.xml. Not modeled.
people.xml (CPerson/CPresenceInfo author presence). No model; co-authoring presence metadata lost.

settings.xml part (1048-line header, ~30 nested classes). word/settings.xml is neither parsed nor emitted by wo-ooxml (grep settings: zero docx hits); evenPastRevisionBehavior/trackChanges state silently dropped.
w:mathPr default math properties. No settings part at all in WO.
w:compat/compatSetting (layout compatibility). Not modeled; layout-mode differences vs OO cannot be configured.
w:docVars document variables. Not modeled.
w:footnotePr/w:endnotePr (numbering format, per-section restart). footnotes survive verbatim but their numbering properties do not.
endnote document props. Not modeled.
w:docProtect (forms/read-only enforcement). Not modeled.
w:zoom view zoom. Not modeled (view state).
fontTable.xml part. Not read/written; embedded font relationships (w:embedRegular) have no path.
Single w:font entry with panose/charset/pitch + embedded font refs. Not modeled.
docProps/app.xml (380 lines: Pages/Words/Chars/Company/Template). Parser reads only docProps/core.xml; app.xml absent from serializer part list.

docProps/core.xml -> CoreProperties{title,creator,subject,description,keywords,language,last_modified_by,created,modified,category,revision}; parse_core_properties (parser.rs:211) + build_core_properties round-trip.
customXml parts + itemProps (376 lines). Not read/written.
customXml schema refs. Not modeled.
Part relationship sets. WO parse_relationships used for _rels/.rels and word/_rels/document.xml.rels (images, hyperlinks, headers/footers). Rels of styles/numbering/footnotes parts never resolved.
Single relationship -> model::Relationship{id,rel_type,target,target_mode}; external hyperlinks carry target_mode=External and feed DocxBody::hyperlink_rels (gap_hyperlink_roundtrip).
[Content_Types].xml: parse_content_types into ContentTypeEntry; serializer regenerates it with conditional overrides (numbering override only when used, serializer.rs:1068).
Override entry folded into ContentTypeEntry{part_name,extension,content_type} model.
Default extension entry, same ContentTypeEntry model.
OO lazy part factory keyed by content type. WO OoxmlParser opens the zip eagerly and reads a fixed part list; unknown parts are skipped silently rather than registered.
OO composite docx file object (all parts + writers). WO equivalent is OoxmlDocument{content_types,relationships,core_properties,docx_body,...}; no writer-side part registry for foreign parts.

Format detection. WO: wo-ooxml detector.rs + wo-x2t router.rs sniff_opc_family reading [Content_Types].xml main strings (F-400/F-401 contract); mislabeled OPC fails loudly (test_mislabeled_opc_container_fails_loudly).
381 lines of format-id constants. WO router registers docx channels (txt/html/odt/rtf/epub/fb2/xps/ofd/hwp/djvu + pdf via F-403); no taxonomy enum mirroring AVS_OFFICESTUDIO_FILE_*.
Graceful unknown-part wrapper. WO skips unknown parts without recording them.
Container navigation (GetPartByType etc., 468 lines). WO has direct zip access only; no part-lookup abstraction.

header/footer parts. Parser resolves the FIRST headerReference/footerReference of each kind into DocxBody{header,footer} (parser.rs:1377+); SectionProperties has header_first/header_even slots but nothing fills them; serializer emits only word/header1.xml+footer1.xml with fixed rId rIdHdr/rIdFtr.
footnotes.xml kept VERBATIM in DocxBody::footnotes_raw and re-emitted unchanged (serializer 4c); test_footnote_round_trip. No typed footnote body model, so converters cannot render footnote text.
Single footnote/endnote body element. Typed model stops at DocxRun.footnote_rid (w:footnoteReference w:id); body content only via raw part.
Separator/continuationSeparator footnotes preserved only because the whole footnotes.xml is carried verbatim.
endnotes.xml part. Zero handling in wo-ooxml (no read, no verbatim capture, no write); endnote references in runs are dropped by parse_run's unmatched-element fallthrough.
w:endnoteReference run content. parse_run handles footnoteReference only.
Word theme part (w:theme). wo-ooxml Theme model is PPTX-only; docx theme1.xml is neither read nor emitted, so themeFontId/themeColor references in foreign documents dangle.
vbaProject.bin macro storage. No path in WO.
jsaProject (OO macros). No path in WO.

OO's 1700-line element dispatch hierarchy (Read/Write per element). WO replaces it with direct (namespace, local_name) match arms in parse_block_children/parse_paragraph/parse_run; verbatim raw_* captures substitute for the un-modeled long tail.
Generic parent/children traversal. WO uses roxmltree node.children()/descendants() in the same dispatch arms.
OO internal binary docx serialization for JS. No WO counterpart (and none needed for the Rust port contract).
See CBinaryFileReader; OO-only runtime artifact.
w:p -> DocxParagraph{style_id,properties,runs,section_properties,raw_ppr,raw_flds}; parse_paragraph + serializer paragraph path. test_ppr_round_trip / test_rich_corpus_round_trip cover it.

971 lines, ~25 nested classes. Typed subset in DocxParagraphProperties (alignment/indents/spacing/keep*/pageBreakBefore/outlineLvl/tabs/numPr/bidi/shd/pBdr/startValue); everything else (framePr, cnfStyle, textDirection, textboxTightWrap, pPrChange, rPrChange) survives only via raw_ppr verbatim capture.
w:jc -> TextAlignment::{Left,Center,Right,Both}; gap_alignment_roundtrip asserts w:jc emission.
indent_left/right/first_line/hanging (twips); c2_2_list_indent_roundtrip asserts w:ind left+hanging.
spacing_before/after/line + spacing_line_rule (LineSpacingRule Auto/Exact/AtLeast).
F-040: properties.shading (w:shd fill) typed field.
F-040: DocxParagraphBorders{top,bottom,left,right} typed field (w:pBdr).
tab_stops: Vec<TabStop{pos,kind,leader}> with TabStopKind Left/Center/Right/Decimal/Bar.
num_id + ilvl + start_value (C2-3 w:startValue restart, c2_3_ol_start_value_roundtrip / c2_3_docx_start_value_parses_to_ol_start).
Text frames (w:framePr drop-cap positioning). Typed model absent; survives only inside verbatim raw_ppr.
Revision metadata (w:pPrChange). Not modeled; revision history lost on round trip.
w:r -> DocxRun (parse_run, 21 field model incl. raw_rpr/drawing/hyperlink_rid/image_rid/extents/footnote_rid/comment_anchor).

785 lines. Typed: bold/italic/underline(kind)/strike/dstrike/font/sz/szCs/color/highlight/vertAlign/smallCaps/allCaps; rest (spacing/position/kern/lang/shd/rStyle/stylisticSets/rPrChange) only via raw_rpr verbatim (test_run_rpr_round_trip).
Run revision tracking. Not typed; inside raw_rpr at best.
OpenType stylistic sets. Not typed.
w:t with xml:space=preserve pushed into run.text; serializer re-emits xml:space=preserve always.
w:delText (deleted text in tracked changes). parse_run has no arm; text vanishes.

w:tab becomes a literal \t inside run.text; the serializer re-emits it as escaped text inside w:t, NOT as a canonical <w:tab/> element (serializer.rs run text path). Visual parity holds, XML parity does not.
w:br type=page -> \u{0C} and back to canonical <w:br w:type="page"/> (serializer.rs:1662); line/column breaks flatten to \n, breaking type distinction.
w:cr -> \r inside run.text; re-emitted as text not <w:cr/>.
w:sym symbol runs (font+charCode). No parse arm; dropped.
w:noBreakHyphen. No parse arm.
w:softHyphen. No parse arm.

Complex fields (w:fldChar begin + w:instrText + separate + end, e.g. TOC/DATE/IF) have NO parse arm at run level; only paragraph-level w:fldSimple is captured. This is the single biggest functional gap vs OO's 667-line CFldChar engine.
Deleted field instructions under tracked changes. Not handled.

Complex-field state machine + form field data (CFFData/CFFTextInput/CFFDDList/CFFCheckBox). WO has no fldChar model; typed field engine is entirely absent (PAGE exists only via raw_flds / x2t generation).

w:fldSimple captured VERBATIM per paragraph in DocxParagraph.raw_flds and re-emitted unchanged; test_header_page_field_round_trip + page_number_span_becomes_docx_page_field_and_back. No typed instruction parsing (no field result recalc).
Legacy form fields (text input, dropdown, checkbox, help/status text). Not modeled.
DocxRun.footnote_rid + serializer re-emission + verbatim footnotes_raw; test_footnote_round_trip.
w:footnoteRef marker inside the footnote body is preserved only via the verbatim footnotes.xml capture.
Pagination hint. Dropped at parse (acceptable: layout-local hint, but must be a documented decision).
Phonetic guides (w:ruby, CJK). Not modeled.
Footnote separators survive via footnotes_raw verbatim only; no typed representation.
Same as CSeparator (verbatim capture).
F-102: becomes CommentAnchor::Start marker run; serializer re-emits in run order.
CommentAnchor::End marker run (same path).
CommentAnchor::Reference marker run; parse_comment_anchors also collects (id,anchor) pairs into DocxBody::comment_anchors.
w:annotationRef in comment bodies. Comment bodies are flattened to plain text, so no annotationRef.
w:bookmarkStart (all bookmarks incl. _Toc anchors). Dropped at parse; TOC anchors cannot survive.
w:bookmarkEnd. Dropped at parse.
Spelling/grammar markers. Dropped (reasonable; note as decision).
Tracked-change insertion (w:ins). Runs inside are parsed, the revision envelope (author/date/id) is lost.
Tracked-change deletion (w:del). delText children are dropped entirely by parse_run.
Move-from revision. Not modeled.
Move-to revision. Not modeled.
Move range markers (4 variants + customXml move/ins/del ranges). None modeled.
Editing-restriction ranges (w:permStart/permEnd). Not modeled.
OOXML datetime value type used by revision/comment envelopes. WO keeps comments' dates as opaque ISO strings; no typed datetime (task-listed gap: full OOXML datetime engine).

DocxRun.hyperlink_rid per run + serializer regrouping of consecutive same-r:id runs into <w:hyperlink>; DocxBody::hyperlink_rels carries the external target; gap_hyperlink_roundtrip. Missing: w:anchor internal links (no bookmark model) and tooltip/history attrs.
w:altChunk external content merging. Not modeled.
w:tbl/tr/tc -> DocxTable/DocxTableRow/DocxTableCell with raw_tbl_pr/raw_tbl_grid/raw_tc_pr verbatim captures; test_table_round_trip + test_table_without_raw_props_uses_typed_fallback.
Grid kept only as verbatim raw_tbl_grid string (typed grid absent); serializer comment explicitly notes 'typed model has no grid representation'.
Column widths live inside raw_tbl_grid; no typed width per column.
Grid revision marker. Dropped.
Row-level table-property exceptions (w:tblPrEx). Dropped at parse.

1954-line property set. Typed: DocxTableProperties{width,indent,alignment,borders(top/left/bottom/right/insideH/insideV)}; everything else (tblStyle, tblLook, tblLayout, shd, cellMar, tblPPr, overlap) only via raw_tbl_pr.
DocxTableBorders + DocxBorder{style,size,color,space} typed model.
Conditional-formatting flags (firstRow/lastRow/band flags). Not typed; inside raw_tbl_pr only.
Table cell margins. Not typed.
Floating table positioning. Not modeled.
Table revision tracking. Not modeled.
DocxTableRow{height,is_header} only; no raw trPr capture, so cantSplit/exact height rule/tblHeader details beyond the two fields are lost.
Horizontal merge folded into DocxTableCell.column_span (continuation cells not modeled as merge-continue).
Vertical merge folded into DocxTableCell.row_span.
w:headers cell-referenced headers (accessibility). Not modeled.
Cell borders survive via raw_tc_pr verbatim; no typed per-cell border model.
Typed subset: column_span/row_span/width/shading; raw_tc_pr verbatim wins over typed when present (test_table_round_trip exercises both paths).
Cell revision tracking. Not modeled.

1820 lines. Typed model SectionProperties has only cols + 6 header/footer slots; the whole section XML is carried verbatim in DocxBody::raw_sect_pr (and stripped of header/footer refs before re-emission, serializer.rs:12-21). Typed pgSz/pgMar/type/titlePg absent.
Page size/orientation only inside raw_sect_pr; no typed field, so converters cannot read page dimensions.
Margins only inside raw_sect_pr.
headerReference/footerReference resolved through word/_rels/document.xml.rels into DocxBody.header/footer (parser.rs:1377+); serializer strips stale refs and re-adds its own (rIdHdr/rIdFtr).
SectionProperties.cols: Option<u8> count only; no per-column w:space/w:sep/equalWidth.
Page borders incl. OO's CTopPageBorder/CBottomPageBorder extensions. Not modeled.
Document grid (CJK layout). Only via raw_sect_pr.
Line numbering settings. Not modeled.
Printer paper source. Not modeled (acceptable; document decision).
Section break type (nextPage/continuous/evenPage/oddPage). Only via raw_sect_pr; wo-ooxml-ops section.rs edits cols/hf but not break type.
Per-section footnote properties. Not modeled.
Section revision tracking. Not modeled.
1861-line content-control engine. WO UNWRAPS w:sdt: parse_block_children (body) takes inner w:p; parse_paragraph (run level) takes inner w:r. Content survives, but the control wrapper does not.
Control metadata (alias/tag/id/appearance/lock). Dropped entirely.
Date-picker content control (calendar/format). Dropped with CSdtPr.
Combo/dropdown content control + list items. Dropped.
Checkbox content control (checked state/symbols). Dropped.
Placeholder text of content controls. Dropped.
Custom-XML data binding of content controls. No customXml part support, so impossible today.
MC:AlternateContent choice/fallback selection. parse arms ignore it; content nested deeper than the known arms is dropped (only exact w:p/w:tbl/sdt at body level are matched).
Glossary/building blocks (502 lines: gallery/category/behaviors). glossary part not read/written.
w:smartTag legacy smart tags. Not modeled.
w:bdo bidi override wrapper. Runs inside survive only if flat, wrapper lost.
w:dir text-direction wrapper. Not modeled (paragraph-level w:bidi IS typed).
w:pict VML fallback (770 lines incl. CBinData/CObject). Only w:drawing is verbatim-captured in parse_run; w:pict subtrees are dropped.
w:pict binary image data. Dropped with CPict.
w:object (OLE object presentation). Dropped.
w:drawing captured verbatim on DocxRun.drawing (test_drawing_round_trip) so arbitrary DrawingML survives round-trip byte-for-byte; typed parse limited to blip r:embed + wp:extent cx/cy.
Inline drawings covered by the verbatim capture + image_width_emu/image_height_emu extraction.
Anchored/floating drawings survive verbatim but wrap mode/position is not typed (DocxImage.wrap_mode exists only for the legacy DocxBlock::Image path).
Wrap variants (none/square/tight/through/topAndBottom/path). Not typed; x2t cannot honor wrapping when rendering.
28 extension classes (sparklines, slicers, timelines, rich values). Not modeled.
3352-line VML shape grammar (arc/curve/group/image/oval/rect/shape/textbox/textpath/shadow/stroke...). Zero coverage; w:pict content dropped at parse.
VML word-specific wrappers (textbox inset etc.). Not modeled.
1944-line o: OML (office shape properties). Not modeled.
word/vmlDrawingN.xml parts (424 lines). Not read/written; headers with VML shapes lose their shapes.
OMML paragraph. w:m:oMath in runs hits parse_run's fallthrough and is dropped; only OMML nested inside a w:drawing would survive verbatim.
Math argument node hierarchy (CMathArgNodes). No formula model in wo-ooxml; wo-formula covers spreadsheets only.
55 classes of math content (fractions, n-ary, matrices, runs). Not modeled.
Math leaf nodes (ctrl props, args/pr). Not modeled.

SmartArt data model (46 classes: dataModel/ptLst/cxnLst). word/diagrams/*.xml parts are not copied on serialize, so SmartArt is lost even though it rides inside a verbatim w:drawing reference — the referenced parts vanish.
SmartArt layout part. Not copied.
SmartArt colors part. Not copied.
SmartArt quickStyle part. Not copied.
SmartArt drawing part. Not copied.
Media part machinery -> MediaPart{name,bytes} read via read_zip_entry_bytes into DocxBody::media; serializer re-embeds them (data-URI in html channel, zip parts on write).
Image parts bound through image_rels (rId -> target) + DocxRun.image_rid; converters emit data-URI with CSS size from image_width_emu/height_emu (LEDGER2 docx->html path).
a:svgBlip SVG extension inside blip extensions. Not extracted; SVG falls back to the raster blip or is lost.
OLE objects (embeddings + o:OLEObject). Not modeled.
15 ActiveX control classes + forms. Not modeled.
Embedded audio. Not modeled.
Embedded video. Not modeled.
External targets -> Relationship.target_mode=External in DocxBody::hyperlink_rels; DocxToHtmlConverter resolves run.hyperlink_rid through it (gap_hyperlink_roundtrip, LEDGER2).
webSettings part (frame/divisors). Not modeled.

WO serializer regenerates _rels/.rels, word/_rels/document.xml.rels (media/hyperlink/hdr-ftr/numbering/styles rels) from the typed model; rels of parts it does not manage (settings, endnotes, fontTable) are consequently absent.
CDocPartObj/CDocPartGallery inside sdtPr marks TOC-of-content-controls; WO drops sdtPr so such markers vanish. Related converter gap: TOC fields have no engine (see CFldChar entry).

OO resolves run/para formatting through the style chain (docDefaults -> style -> direct). WO has no style-resolution engine: converters read only direct formatting + style_id string; test gap acknowledged in converter_gaps (run styling tests use direct formatting only).

oo_class: COoxmlSerializer part completeness vs OO writer
notes: OO's writer emits the full part set; WO serializer writes [Content_Types].xml, rels, document.xml, header1/footer1, footnotes.xml, numbering.xml (conditional), comments(+extended), styles.xml, docProps/core.xml. Missing writes: endnotes, settings, fontTable, app, theme, customXml, vbaProject, glossary, diagrams.

OO File::ReadFromBinary dispatches via format checker. WO OoxmlParser::parse_to_document assumes OPC zip; no password-encrypted OPC path (router convert_with_password exists but does not decrypt OOXML agile encryption).
Comment.date kept as raw ISO string; no xsd:dateTime normalization/validation (parse accepts any string).
Header/footer blocks parse only w:p/w:tbl via the same parse_block_children; VML textboxes anchored in headers drop their shapes (only paragraph text survives).
